text:
Tess: Quick QA note from mobile testing — on narrow phones the console table rows feel cramped and the action chevron's hit area is tiny. Repro: Console -> Jobs -> narrow width ~360px -> try tapping chevron. GIF: https://redwood-internal.screens/chevron-tap.gif

Rohan: Oh thats rough. Do you see missed taps or the chevron visually outside the touch target?

Tess: Missed taps. The visual chevron looks fine but the actual clickable area seems shifted slightly left; sometimes you have to tap twice. Also when the left rail is in icon-only mode the row content shifts a few px causing a micro-jump.

Kai: Likely cause: compact row padding + negative margins for the action cell. On small widths we collapse labels and tighten padding, which reduces the touchable area below 44px. We should maintain 44px min touch targets per a11y guidelines.

Iman: UX options: 1) keep visual size but expand hit target via padding on the interactive element; 2) hide chevron and add a single overflow menu per row (kebab) that portals to body; 3) make action area sticky so it never gets squished by rail changes. Thoughts?

Tess: I like option 1 for quickest fix. Option 2 is cleaner for discovery but needs design work. Option 3 could be weird on very narrow screens.

Rohan: Engineering note: when the rail switches from full -> icon-only we animate width which can cause layout thrash for table cells. If we instead animate only transform on the rail (overlay or translateX) the table won't reflow. But transforms create stacking contexts and can clip popovers. So if we animate transform, we need to portal popovers.

Kai: Good call. Also add padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to the table container so iOS bottom bars don't obscure rows. And avoid using 100vh for container height; use min-height with visualViewport listeners to reduce jumps when the address bar collapses.

Iman: Accessibility/copy nits: the small toggle should be labelled "Open navigation" not "Collapse" for screen readers. Also update the tooltip text for the chevron to "Row actions" and ensure visible focus outline for keyboard users.

Tess: I'll push a tiny tweak branch that expands chevron hit targets to 44px with no visual changes and adds the env() shim. Can design add a quick variant showing kebab-overflow vs chevron for narrow rows?

Kai: I'll also implement a portal for the row action popover and use position: fixed so it stays above the rail overlay. I'll add an opt-in feature flag to toggle the two-step rail behavior (icon-only at 480, overlay <=440) so we can test both.

Rohan: For breakpoints, can we standardize on: full >=521, icons-only 441-520, overlay <=440? That gives a clear UX ladder and matches other product shells. If we need to tweak, make them CSS variables.

Iman: Copy agree. One more small accessibility thing: reduce tooltip activation delay on touch devices or disable tooltips entirely for touch. They block taps and create a noisy experience.

design-bot: Uploaded quick variants to sandbox (360x, 420x, 480x), added tags: mobile-responsive, ux, a11y.
